mapper.update: UPDATE room SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room (hotel_id, room_number, type_name, price, status, img1, img2, img3) VALUES (#{hotelId}, #{roomNumber}, #{typeName}, #{price}, #{status}, #{img1}, #{img2}, #{img3})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT type_name FROM room WHERE hotel_id = #{hotelId}
